name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-sharepoint-governance-copilot
title: Governance Risk Advisor — Executive Tenant Governance Dashboard
shortDescription: A SharePoint Copilot App (SPFx 1.24 Copilot Component) that turns tenant governance findings into an executive briefing: a governance score with trend, an AI-generated executive summary, prioritized remediation actions, explainable findings, and a tenant-wide insights panel.
longDescription: Governance Risk Advisor is a SharePoint Copilot App built as an SPFx 1.24 Copilot Component (not a classic web part). Instead of a flat list of governance risks, it opens with a 0-100 governance score and a trend indicator (Improving, Stable, Declining), an AI-style executive summary of the tenant's posture, and the top 3-5 prioritized remediation actions ranked by severity-weighted impact.

Findings are shown severity-first: high and medium findings are always visible, while low-priority findings are collapsed behind a 'Show low-priority findings' toggle. Every finding explains the Risk, Impact, Why this matters, and Recommended action in business language, with a primary remediation call-to-action (for example Assign Owner, Review Permissions, Review Guest Access, Start Access Review) that sends a follow-up message back into the Copilot conversation, plus a secondary Open site link.

A tenant-wide insights panel (sites without owners, sites inactive 180+ days, sites with anonymous sharing, sites with excessive guest access, expiring reviews) and an estimated risk reduction projection round out the executive story. The sample ships with mocked data behind a swappable IGovernanceService interface, so a live Microsoft Graph / SharePoint Admin API implementation can be dropped in without touching the UI. Built with the Heft build system, React and Fluent UI v9 with host-driven light/dark theming.
